_note: Curated recording of a real broken-mode assessment, for offline demos. The rationales mirror a real Claude-driven run. Labelled as RECORDED in the UI.

steps.rationale: Before any access test, establish what the discovered key actually grants. This is an offline, non-intrusive check.
The key is a public anon key and the app references a 'trips' table; test whether an unauthenticated client can read it.
steps.detail: anonymous request returned 2 row(s) from a resource expected to be restricted

steps.rationale: Repeat the minimal anonymous read against 'invoices', another referenced table.
steps.detail: anonymous request returned 2 row(s) from a resource expected to be restricted

steps.rationale: Check 'profiles' as well to avoid missing a leak.
steps.detail: anonymous request was accepted but returned no rows — inconclusive

steps.rationale: With an authorized test account, verify tenant isolation on 'trips' — a logged-in user must not see other tenants' rows.
steps.detail: authenticated user saw rows from 1 other tenant(s) — isolation failure

steps.rationale: Authorized admin access is available; review RLS posture per discovered table.
All candidate tables and authorized checks are covered.

findings.title: Unauthorized anonymous read of 'trips'
findings.impact: An unauthenticated client read rows from 'trips', which should be access-controlled.
findings.remediation: Enable Row Level Security on 'trips' and restrict anonymous access; verify grants.

findings.title: Unauthorized anonymous read of 'invoices'
findings.impact: An unauthenticated client read rows from 'invoices', which should be access-controlled.
findings.remediation: Enable RLS on 'invoices' and define restrictive policies; re-test anon and authenticated.

findings.title: Cross-tenant data access in 'trips' (authenticated)
findings.impact: An authenticated test user read rows belonging to OTHER tenants from 'trips'. Tenant isolation is not enforced.
findings.remediation: Add an RLS policy scoping rows to the caller's tenant (JWT tenant claim); re-test with multiple tenants.

findings.title: Row Level Security disabled on 'trips'
findings.impact: Admin metadata review shows RLS is disabled on 'trips'; row-level controls are not enforced at the DB layer.
findings.remediation: ALTER TABLE trips ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and define policies; verify grants do not bypass RLS.
